precedence: Apply to B28 v8 provisional research picks BEFORE proposing atlas primary; rubrical accuracy and physical relevance precede aesthetics and licensing.

rubrical_sources.name: 1962 General Rubrics of the Roman Missal, §§525–529
rubrical_sources.use: Altar, three linens, crucifix, candlesticks, altar cards, missal stand/cushion, cruets on credence.

rubrical_sources.name: Ritus servandus in celebratione Missae
rubrical_sources.use: Priest places the Missal on its stand on the Epistle side; ceremonial function must align with photograph.

rubrical_sources.name: John B. O'Connell, The Celebration of Mass (1962), material requisites
rubrical_sources.use: Preconciliar ceremonial handbook for usual functional requirements, not one canonical mandatory artistic style.

critical_logic: An eligible museum object may be an authentic historical specimen without being the primary exemplar for a layman's view of the 1962 Traditional Latin Mass. CC0 photographic copyright never compensates for historical/type mismatch. Different legitimate parish practices do not become illicit because one illustration is preferred.

source_references_for_comparison_only.note: Contemporary extraordinary-form preparation photo illustrates ordinary clear glass cruets with tray; image-level publication permission not granted. Reference only.
Hanging red-glass sanctuary lamp shape reference. Commercial image rights unverified; never directly import.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Sanctuary lamp
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Wall-mounted Auckland sanctuary lamp is valid Catholic but a suspended sanctuary lamp with red glass beside a traditional tabernacle is more immediately representative.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Hanging three-chain lamp with red vessel; Roman Catholic traditional altar; isolated or sharply focused complete lamp; exact source photograph rights.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Keep current photo only as wall-mounted contemporary variant; don't label it usual hanging form.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: High altar
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Actual complete French high altar without a modern forward table; an architecturally coherent in-situ view is appropriate.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Reconfirm altar and associated furnishings and liturgical arrangement under visual acceptance.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Tabernacle
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Unveiled Auckland tabernacle is clear, but modern cylindrical presentation is not the best visual anchor for a traditional fixed high altar.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Eucharistic tabernacle visibly integrated with Roman Catholic high altar and central door, identifiable without detached forward altar table.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Keep Auckland as legitimate contemporary variant; no false claim that the 1962 rites forbid this form.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Altar crucifix
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Nineteenth-century rock crystal/silver altar crucifix is authentic, but a typical recognizable standing corpus crucifix better explains usual parish furnishing.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Complete freestanding traditional Catholic crucifix with corpus, balanced upright base, appropriate for altar.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Retain ornate museum specimen in historical gallery, not mandatory first illustration.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Consecrated altar stone
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Consecrated altar stone and relic cavity have a direct traditional-rite teaching role.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Verify five crosses, real relic cavity/seal at 100% pixel and explanatory context.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Keep conditional pending precise visual proof.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Three altar cards
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Historically authentic ornate Livorno silver altar-card set is less typical than standard three-card Mass arrangement.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Real central card and two side cards in customary arrangement, clear lettering, traditional Roman Mass provenance.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Keep ornate ensemble as alternate decorative type only.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Chalice
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Recognizable Catholic chalice; historical metalwork may represent proper form.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Review bowl, stem, foot, material and source rights; avoid misleading unusual forms.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Paten
audited_provisional_candidates.why: A paten alone meets object function and conventional TLM presentation.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Ensure correct Eucharistic chalice paten, not communion plate.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Ciborium
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Improve grayscale image if superior colour conventional example is found.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Communion paten / plate
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Handled communion plate fits traditional practice.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Check shape and handle in actual photographic context.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Corporal
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Prefer plain square white linen as most legible archetype if equivalent rights-clear source exists.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Keep conditional; don't assume decorative weave prohibited.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Purificator
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Multicolour-embroidered purificator is an example, but plain white linen with modest central red cross is a clearer ordinary teaching archetype.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: A complete clean white purificator clearly identified by Catholic sacristy or liturgical source; small cross if present, folded/use view.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Do not assert that multicolour embroidery is illicit; difference is representativeness.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Pall for chalice
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Square chalice pall with IHS is an acceptable specimen.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Ensure stiff chalice pall, not loose linen covering.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Burse
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Burse is proper Roman chalice-dressing component.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Check orientation, folded shape, vestment-matching character; distinguish from pyx pouch.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Chalice veil
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Full chalice veil is appropriately identified.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Prefer arranged-over-the-chalice in-use context as a complementary image, not necessarily replacement.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Water cruet
audited_provisional_candidates.why: c.1500 Gothic gold cruet is exact Catholic Mass water vessel but highly exceptional relative to ordinary modern TLM altar service.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Clear identified water cruet, preferably small transparent glass with matching wine cruet, A/aqua mark or documented content, in a 1962-useful pair.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Keep historic Kraków image in historical museum supplement with its date; never call it typical 1962.

audited_provisional_candidates.label: Altar bell
audited_provisional_candidates.why: Carcassonne nineteenth-century enameled altar bell is valid but ornate museum specimen, and background less useful than a familiar server handbell.
audited_provisional_candidates.preferred_1962_reference_form: Common Roman Catholic single handbell or small altar-bell group typical of Low Mass, shown singly/defined set with suitable attribution.
audited_provisional_candidates.disposition: Keep Carcassonne in historical sacred metalwork; the 1962 form need not be this precise design.

rights_hard_gate: No source photograph may be shipped without exact-photo permission and attribution regardless of how high it ranks for TLM representativeness; licensing is an independent mandatory pass/fail gate, not a lower-weight preference.
